Jess: Hi — I'm Jess (started today). Trying to complete oncall prep but hitting a couple of access issues. PD says 'no access to schedules'. Can someone confirm I should be in the "oncall-rotation" schedule?
Luca: hey jess! I added you to the PD schedule, fyi. do you still see the error?
Jess: still seeing 403 when I try to view schedule. Also can't access the private runbooks at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall. getting a 404.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: New user jess added to schedule "eng-oncall" by luca.
Maria: 404 on runbooks usually means SSO group not synced. @samir — did the SCIM sync finish this morning?
Samir: SCIM finished at 09:12 but the runbooks are behind a permission flag — runbooks require 'oncall' LDAP group. jess, can you confirm you accepted the SSO invite? If not, check email or go to https://login.redwood.example/sso
Jess: accepted invite and SSO profile shows my groups include 'engineering' but not 'oncall'.
Samir: ok I'll add you to LDAP group now, give me 5.
Jess: thanks
Samir: done. try again?
Jess: runbook link works now! able to view runbook "pg-lag". PD schedule still errors.
Luca: For PD try clearing cookies or use incognito; sometimes SSO redirect stale. If still 403 I'll DM infra to check PD role mapping.
Jess: cleared and it's working — I can see the rotation. Thanks. Quick question: my first shadow is tomorrow 10:00 with Anya — should I run the pager test before then?
Anya: yep, let's do a quick 10-min drill at 09:50. We'll simulate a latency incident: follow runbook 'latency-high' and practice the comms template. I'll post the mock alert payload in the thread.
Anya: mock alert:
```
ALERT: latency.p95 > 800ms
service: inference-runtime
region: us-east-1
urgency: high
```
Jess: got it. Any tips on what to log during the drill?
Maria: focus on timeline (what you did + timestamps), commands you ran, and the routing decision. Use the incident channel template in runbook.
Jess: thanks! One last ask — who do I page for infra-level GPU OOMs vs model-level decoding errors?
Luca: infra gpu-oom -> page 'eng-infra' and CC 'platform-sre'. model decoding -> 'eng-ml' then escalate to 'eng-runtime' if it looks like perf regression.
Jess: perfect. See you tomorrow, and thanks everyone :smile:
oncall-bot: scheduled drill reminder set for 2028-05-12 09:40.
